The '''Inferno Turret''' was the primary defensive weapon for the [[Nym's Base|base]] of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], located on the planet of [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Inferno Turret defended several Revenant scouts and transports when the base was [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|attacked]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] megacorporation. Once the turret was fully online its firepower was enough to dissuade even heavily-shielded [[Trade Federation Dropship]]s from moving within its line of fire. In the end the Inferno Turret was scuttled, alongside the rest of the base, as part of a trap to destroy a Trade Federation [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]].
